verdict.rationale: Buzz documents first-party self-hosting of its core relay. It ships a Helm chart on GHCR with production and quickstart profiles, and a probe confirmed the published chart versions are live. It also ships a single-node/VPS compose bundle, and its vision explicitly says you can run your own relay from the same OSS codebase. missing for 10: independent hands-on report of a successful self-hosted deployment, detailed docs for the compose/VPS path.
